_note: Visa sponsorship as a posting fact (PLAN.md v16, step 8), not a skill. pipeline/sponsorship.py reads a posting's text: when a `no` pattern matches the posting says it does not sponsor ("no"); else when a `yes` pattern matches it says it does ("yes"); else null, which is most postings. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions anchored on visa, immigration, work-authorization or H-1B words, so a project sponsor, a company-sponsored event or a sponsored clearance never counts. Labelled examples: evals/sponsorship.json, checked by evals/run_pipeline.py --only sponsorship.
